description: Autoridad Portuaria de Barcelona: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria de Barcelona. Coverage: Autoridad Portuaria de Barcelona. The listing groups 19 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plano callejero del Puerto de Barcelona, a escala 1:12.000; Terminales marítimas del Puerto de Barcelona; Llegadas a 7 días muelles OPS; Aproximación al puerto. Formats seen: CSV, GEO%2BPDF, PLAIN, DWG, DGN. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
